messages:
sam: Quick proposal: collapse the two routing headers into a single negotiated header to cut proxy lookups and enable atomic versioning.

sam: Today we emit `X-Redwood-Route: {...}` and `X-Redwood-Quota: standard`, proposal is `Redwood-Route: v=2;enc=b64;data=...` where data is a small JSON blob base64-encoded.

linh: Can you share a real wire example? worried about header size and parsing ergonomics in SDKs.

sam: Example: `Redwood-Route: v=2;enc=b64;data=eyJwb2xpY3kiOiJub3Jyb3dDYXN0IiwiYXF1b2RhIjoi c3RhbmRhcmQifQ==` (decodes to `{"policy":"narrowcast","quota":"standard"}`). We'll keep payload compact and cap sizes.

maya: Console needs stable keys to map into the routing dashboard. List the canonical keys and allowed enums please.

omar: Console suggestion: require `policy`, `quota`, `affinity` (affinity optional). Allowed policies = narrowcast | broadcast | fallback, quota = standard | premium | burst. affinity = string tag.

elena: Runtime concern: some edge proxies limit header size; base64 increases size ~33%. We must keep v2 optional and ensure SDKs fall back to v1 when size exceeds threshold. Also ensure binary-safe transit.

linh: SDK work: we can implement encoder/decoder + negotiation but that requires minor bumps for py/ts/go. Plan to gate behind a feature flag in each SDK.

sam: Rollout plan: SDKs implement v2 behind `route.v2.enabled=false`. Servers advertise supported versions via `Redwood-Server-Flags` on init or ping. If `route-v2` present, SDK toggles emission. Default stays v1 for 6 weeks, then flip after telemetry review. Full sunsetting after 12 weeks.

linh: Negotiation detail: servers echo flags on `POST /v1/sessions` or `GET /internal/ping`. SDKs should cache flags per-host for 10 minutes to avoid extra calls. If server responds 415/parsing error, SDK falls back and marks `fallback_v1` event.

maya: DevEx ask: can console provide a per-customer toggle so support can opt a customer into route-v2 for testing?

omar: Yes, console API can set a flag that the control plane watches and includes in `Redwood-Server-Flags`. We'll add an admin endpoint.

elena: Security: base64 payload must be validated and never logged. Don't include any PII in affinity tags. Add max pre-encode payload size 512 bytes; if exceeded, SDKs should truncate affinity or emit `affinity=auto-hash`.

linh: Telemetry: SDKs will emit `sdk.route.header.format` with values `v1_emitted`, `v2_emitted`, `negotiated_v2`, `fallback_v1`. We'll sample at 100% for 2 weeks then reduce. Also emit `sdk.route.header.size_bytes`.

sam: Console/observability: map `policy` and `quota` to existing tiles; affinity can be a filter. Please document key names and enums in the internal spec.

linh: Implementation tasks for SDKs: add encoder/decoder util, feature flag, negotiation cache, preflight `GET /internal/ping` to read flags, unit tests, e2e with test proxy enforcing header limits. Changelog entry and migration guide included.

elena: Runtime tests: create a proxy test that returns 431 when header >4KB; SDKs must handle gracefully. Also add integration test where server returns a `Redwood-Server-Flags: route-v2=false` after previously true to ensure backoff.

sam: I'll write the API spec and PR it to `internal/api` repo. Keep server-side parser forgiving for both `v1` and `v2` until sunsetting.

linh: We'll coordinate release windows: py/ts first, go shortly after. Each SDK will default to flag=false initially. We'll communicate breaking changes in the release notes.

maya: @omar can console team prepare the per-customer toggle UI + API and note audit logging for toggles?

omar: Yep, will add API + UI, and ensure audit log entry when toggled.

deploy-bot: preflight passed for `eng-platform/route-header-v2-spec` PR 5489 by sam.

maya: Solid. Let's keep the rollout conservative and watch `sdk.route.header.format` closely. @linh start branches and post links when ready.

linh: Will do, expect branch and draft changelog by EOD tomorrow.

sam: Thanks everyone. I'll paste the spec link here once PR merges.
